testCases.title: Successful Filtering by Category
steps: Select a specific category from the filter options.
Click on the filter button or apply filter.
expectedResults: Items are displayed that belong to the selected category.

testCases.title: Invalid Category Selection
steps: Select an invalid category from the filter options.
Click on the filter button or apply filter.
expectedResults: No items are displayed, and an appropriate error message is shown.

testCases.title: Filter Results Update on New Category Selection
steps: Select an initial category from the filter options.
Click on the filter button or apply filter.
Select a new category from the filter options.
Click on the filter button or apply filter again.
expectedResults: Items displayed are updated to reflect only those belonging to the newly selected category.
